_comment: TEST-DISCOVER consumption of EPIC-PREP downstream_hints provisioning and ANALYSE deferral_obligation_keyed suppression. Playbook Steps A, C-fixture, E, F. Verifier: discover_verify.py --strict-principal. Upstream: docs/epic-prep-principal-contract.json, docs/coverage-principal-contract.json, docs/analysis-principal-contract.json.

provision_scan.ref_filter: obligations_proposed[] where downstream_hints.needs_environment_provision == true OR kind == environment_setup
provision_scan.coverage_match: primary checks[] with obligation_ids[] containing provision obligation id

widget_ui_account_group_setup.when: ref.epic_archetype.value == widget_ui AND provision obligation with account_group or publish keywords

metrics_calculation_console.when: ref.epic_archetype.value == metrics_calculation AND ladder/console primary checks

fixture_emit_rules.dual_account_note: When needs_dual_account_contrast true, notes mention ENRG/OPPT contrast — no secrets

deferral_ledger_rules.disposition_note: Cite obligation_id from analysis deferred_check gap or coverage obligations_coverage.deferred_in_check

forbidden: scope_gap on primary checks with analysis exploration_suppressed deferral_obligation_keyed
missing fixture_needs row when ref provision obligation has matching primary coverage check
probe_executed on deferral-keyed suppressed primary checks

strict_principal_verifier.skip_when_no_principal: ref has no provision obligations and no principal_coverage_threads and no verification_focus_proposed
rules: each ref provision obligation id appears in fixture_needs[].linked_obligation_ids with linked primary check
each primary check with analysis deferral_obligation_keyed has ledger disposition != scope_gap
validation_log contains phaseC-principal when ref has provision obligations
validation_log may contain phaseE_skipped_deferral_keyed when keyed deferrals acknowledged

COVERAGE-REINFORCE.use: Pass-2 detail_lines merge for setup primaries and deferral skip-deepen (Round 2 step 5)

TEST-PRECON.use: Session placeholders, precon_clusters pc-setup provisioning paste (Round 2 step 6); see docs/precon-principal-contract.json
